lines.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the Path is known.
With the Guru's Support, one is blessed with the strength of the True Lord.
Dwell on the Naam, and realize the Beauteous Word of His Bani.
If it is Your Will, Lord, You lead me to find Your Door. ||2||
Flying high or sitting down, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I take the Naam as my Suppport.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਨ ਊਚੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jal doo(n)gar na oochee dhaar ||
lines.translation: There is no ocean of water, no mountain ranges rising up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਹ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa tah mag na chaalanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: I dwell within the home of my own inner being, where there is no path and no one travelling on it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬੀਜਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ghar vasahi toohai bidh jaanahi beejau mahal na jaapai ||
lines.translation: You alone know the way to that House in which You dwell. No one else knows the Mansion of Your Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਬਿਆ ਛਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur baajhahu samajh na hovee sabh jag dabiaa chhaapai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no understanding. The whole world is buried under its nightmare.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan palaav karai bilalaatau bin gur naam na jaapai ||
lines.translation: The mortal tries all sorts of things, and weeps and wails, but without the Guru, he does not know the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pal pa(n)kaj mahi naam chhadaae je gurasabad sinjaapai ||4||
lines.translation: In the twinkling of an eye, the Naam saves him, if he realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik satigur kai bhai naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: Some, through fear of the True Guru, take the Support of the Naam.
The True Word of His Bani is sweet, the source of ambrosial nectar.
Whoever drinks it in, finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam bhai bhaai ridai vasaahee gur karanee sach baanee ||
lines.translation: One who, through the love and fear of God, enshrines the Naam within his heart, acts according to the Guru's Instructions and knows the True Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)d varasai dharat suhaavee ghat ghat jot samaanee ||
lines.translation: When the clouds release their rain, the earth becomes beautiful; God's Light permeates each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰਿ ਬੀਜਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਐਸੀ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaalar beejas duramat aisee nigure kee neesaanee ||
lines.translation: The evil-minded ones plant their seed in the barren soil; such is the sign of those who have no Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur baajhahu ghor a(n)dhaaraa doob mue bin paanee ||6||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there is utter darkness; they drown there, even without water. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keeno s prabhoo rajaai ||
lines.translation: Whatever God does, is by His Own Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s metanaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.
Bound to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal does his deeds.
Permeated by the One Word of the Shabad, the mortal is immersed in Truth. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu dis hukam varatai prabh teraa chahu dis naam pataala(n) ||
lines.translation: Your Command, O God, rules in the four directions; Your Name pervades the four corners of the nether regions as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi sabad varatai prabh saachaa karam milai baiaala(n) ||
lines.translation: The True Word of the Shabad is pervading amongst all. By His Grace, the Eternal One unites us with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਊਭੌ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n)man maranaa deesai sir oobhau khudhiaa nidraa kaala(n) ||
lines.translation: Birth and death hang over the heads of all beings, along with hunger, sleep and dying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai man bhaavai saachee nadar rasaala(n) ||8||1||4||
lines.translation: The Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind; O True Lord, Source of bliss, please bless me with Your Grace. ||8||1||4||
Malaar, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran mukat gat saar na jaanai ||
lines.translation: You do not understand the nature of death and liberation.
You are sitting on the river-bank; realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
You stork! - how were you caught in the net?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: alakh na jaachahi ridai samhaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You do not remember in your heart the Unseen Lord God. ||1||Pause||
For your one life, you consume many lives.
You were supposed to swim in the water, but you are drowning in it instead. ||2||
You have tormented all beings.
When Death seizes you, then you shall regret and repent. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸ ਪੜੀ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab gal phaas paRee at bhaaree ||
lines.translation: When the heavy noose is placed around your neck,
you may spread your wings, but you shall not be able to fly. ||4||
You enjoy the tastes and flavors, you foolish self-willed manmukh.
You are trapped. You can only be saved by virtuous conduct, spiritual wisdom and contemplation. ||5||
Serving the True Guru, you will shatter the Messenger of Death.
In your heart, dwell on the True Word of the Shabad. ||6||
The Guru's Teachings, the True Word of the Shabad, is excellent and sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaar ||7||
lines.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਆਗੈ ਜਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: se dukh aagai j bhog bilaase ||
lines.translation: One who is obsessed with enjoying pleasures here, shall suffer in pain hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mukat nahee bin naavai saache ||8||2||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there is no liberation without the True Name. ||8||2||5||
